name: Paracetamol
general_purpose: Used for temporary relief of pain and reduction of fever.
common_uses: Temporary relief of mild to moderate pain
general_action: It reduces pain and fever. Its exact mechanism is not fully understood.
general_warnings: Taking too much can cause serious liver damage.
Some combination medicines also contain paracetamol, so ingredient labels matter.
common_side_effects: Side effects are uncommon when used as directed; serious allergic reactions can occur.
availability_note: Availability and prescription requirements can vary by product and location.

name: Ibuprofen
general_purpose: Used to relieve pain, fever, and inflammation.
general_action: It reduces the production of prostaglandins, substances involved in pain, fever, and inflammation.
general_warnings: NSAIDs can cause stomach ulcers or bleeding and may increase cardiovascular or kidney risks in some people.
Risks depend on personal health and other medicines.
availability_note: Availability and prescription requirements can vary by product strength and location.

name: Aspirin
general_purpose: Used for pain and fever; some formulations are used under clinical guidance for cardiovascular purposes.
general_action: It reduces prostaglandin production and also affects platelet activity.
general_warnings: It can irritate the stomach and increase bleeding risk.
Aspirin use in children or teenagers with viral illnesses has been associated with Reye syndrome.
common_side_effects: Increased tendency to bruise or bleed
availability_note: Availability and prescription requirements can vary by formulation and location.

name: Amoxicillin
general_purpose: An antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections.
common_uses: Treatment of certain infections caused by susceptible bacteria
general_action: It interferes with the formation of bacterial cell walls.
general_warnings: It does not treat viral infections such as colds or influenza.
Allergic reactions can occur, particularly in people with penicillin allergy.
availability_note: Prescription requirements vary by location; antibiotic use should be guided by a qualified healthcare professional.

name: Azithromycin
general_purpose: An antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections.
common_uses: Treatment of certain infections caused by susceptible bacteria
general_action: It interferes with bacterial protein production by binding to the bacterial 50S ribosomal subunit.
general_warnings: It does not treat viral infections such as colds or influenza.
It can affect heart rhythm in some people and can interact with other medicines.
availability_note: Prescription requirements vary by location; antibiotic use should be guided by a qualified healthcare professional.

name: Cetirizine
general_purpose: Used to relieve symptoms associated with allergies.
common_uses: Relief of sneezing, runny nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching
general_action: It blocks histamine at H1 receptors; histamine contributes to many allergy symptoms.
general_warnings: It can cause drowsiness in some people.
Alcohol and other medicines that cause drowsiness may increase this effect.
availability_note: Availability and prescription requirements can vary by product and location.

name: Loratadine
general_purpose: Used to relieve symptoms associated with allergies.
common_uses: Relief of sneezing, runny nose, itchy or watery eyes, and itching
general_action: It blocks histamine at H1 receptors; histamine contributes to many allergy symptoms.
general_warnings: Drowsiness is possible, though it is generally less likely than with some older antihistamines.
availability_note: Availability and prescription requirements can vary by product and location.

name: Omeprazole
common_uses: Treatment of conditions involving excess stomach acid, including gastroesophageal reflux
general_action: It blocks proton pumps in the stomach lining that release acid.
general_warnings: Long-term use may have risks and should be discussed with a healthcare professional.
Persistent or severe symptoms warrant professional assessment.
availability_note: Availability and prescription requirements can vary by product, duration, and location.

name: Pantoprazole
common_uses: Treatment of conditions involving excess stomach acid, including gastroesophageal reflux
general_action: It blocks proton pumps in the stomach lining that release acid.
general_warnings: Long-term use may have risks and should be discussed with a healthcare professional.
Persistent or severe symptoms warrant professional assessment.
availability_note: Availability and prescription requirements can vary by product and location.

name: Metformin
general_purpose: Used to help manage blood glucose in type 2 diabetes.
common_uses: Management of type 2 diabetes, alongside an overall care plan
general_action: It lowers glucose production by the liver and improves the body's response to insulin.
general_warnings: A rare but serious condition called lactic acidosis is associated with metformin.
Kidney function and other health factors can affect its suitability.

name: Amlodipine
general_purpose: Used to treat high blood pressure and certain types of angina.
common_uses: Management of certain types of chest pain (angina)
general_action: It relaxes blood vessels by blocking calcium entry into certain muscle cells.
general_warnings: It may cause dizziness or swelling; individual risks and medicine changes should be discussed with a healthcare professional.
common_side_effects: Swelling of the ankles or feet

name: Atorvastatin
general_purpose: Used to lower cholesterol and reduce certain cardiovascular risks.
common_uses: Reduction of certain risks of heart attack and stroke
general_action: It inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, an enzyme involved in cholesterol production in the liver.
general_warnings: Unexplained muscle pain or weakness can require prompt professional assessment.
Pregnancy and some other health circumstances affect its use.
